purpose: Rights register for the clean-room AIAssistent1 local-calendar SFT v9 dataset.

review.decision_evidence: Direct rights-holder authorization in the Codex task on 2026-08-29 confirms that the V8 and V9 train and validation files belong to the project, contain no personal data, and are permitted for model training and derivative-weight distribution. Earlier project sources retain the verified authorization recorded by the V7 register. The V8 and V9 additions were manually authored from fictional calendar scenarios. The dataset generator was not run for these additions; prepare_dataset.py only transformed checked-in approved sources into the exact staged V9 artifacts.
